sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-Heretic-MTP-APEX-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is DeepReinforce's Qwen3.5 MoE agentic coding model. This experimental derivative merges the selected Heretic 1.4.0 Trial 62 LoRA into BF16 weights. The shipped native MTP head is untrained (initializer-like statistics). It is replaced here with the 19-tensor fused BF16 head from shisa-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MTP-ONLY (Qwen3.6 graft + 12K KL distillation). Refusal-modified ...

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: DeepReinforce Ornith-1.5 family released - NVIDIA Developer Forums
sources.snippet: Looks like DeepReinforce released a bunch of Ornith-1.5 models today: 9B, 35B-A3B, 397B in a nice mix of quants/formats. The 35B-A3B looks interesting for a single-node setup. Downloading on one of my GX10s to give it a run through. Anyone already give it a go? Text-only per the model card, so not a direct competitor/replacement for Qwen3.6-35B, perhaps.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-DGX-Spark/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B for DGX Spark by Mia'a AI Lab Serve Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B — a ~35B mixture-of-experts model (~3B active params/token) from the Ornith team — on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 / SM121, ~128 GB unified memory): NVFP4 checkpoint, vLLM, in-checkpoint MTP speculative decoding, and up to 256k context.
